options.text: No solutions, because a cube cannot be negative
options.why: Confused cubes with squares; $(-3)^{3}=-27$, so a cube can be negative.

questions.solution_text:
$4x^{3}=-108$
$x^{3}=-27$
Every number has exactly one real cube root, so there is one solution.
$x=-3$

$5x^{3}=200$
$x^{3}=40$
$x=\sqrt[3]{40}$
$x\approx 3.42$
The side length is about $3.42$ cm.
